outputs.explanation: Panel A is a schematic diagram illustrating exposure time vs. illumination overhead timing with single percentage values per condition, not a quantitative plot of averaged data requiring individual points.
Panel B is a line plot with shaded error bands (mean±s.e.m.); line plots are exempt from the individual-data-points requirement as overlaying points would make them unreadable.
Panel C is a scatter plot of ΔROS vs exposure time with error bars per point; scatter plots inherently show individual (grouped) data points and are exempt.
Panel D shows individual migration tracks (line plots) for single cells, not an averaged summary statistic, so overlaying additional individual points is not applicable; line plots are exempt.
Panel E is a bar chart of mean±s.e.m. migration speed with individual data points (dots) for each cell overlaid on the bars.
Panel F consists of fluorescence micrographs, not a quantitative plot.
Panel G is a time-series of micrographs, not a quantitative plot.
Panel H is a time-series of micrographs, not a quantitative plot.
Panel I is a line plot (normalized cell area over time) with error bars (mean±s.e.m.); line plots are exempt from requiring individual data points.
Panel J is a line plot (normalized mitochondrial area over time) with error bars (mean±s.e.m.); line plots are exempt from requiring individual data points.
